description: See how much prompt caching each turn reuses and what its tokens would cost at Standard API rates. Expand the Cache panel for per-request reads and writes, first-request cache use, and estimated time left. Open the Cache marker under an assistant reply for saved turn details, or Session statistics for totals and turn history. Optional time-limited keepalive sends ordinary paid turns through your configured provider; cache hits and savings are not guaranteed. Requires BB 0.48+ and Plugin SDK 0.6.104+; Claude Code Telemetry support requires that separate provider plugin.
